name: mame06
title: MAME 0.6 (DJGPP + Allegro, 1997)
_doc: MAME 0.6: Scramble, Uniwars, Frogger and its bootleg on a Scramble board, Amidar, Turtles and Rally X join, the Wizard of Wor video hardware is redone and the Galaxian family gets its star field. The source tree was reorganised -- one directory per KIND of file (drivers, machine, vidhrdw, sndhrdw) with files named after the game, instead of one directory per game -- which is why this is its own unit list and not 0.5's with additions.
_units: The makefile's OBJS list, in its order. obj/osdepend.o has its own rule pointing at src/msdos/msdos.c -- MAME's own DOS backend, compiled rather than replaced. src/sndhrdw/Psg.c is not a unit: cclimber.c includes it.
_include: The makefile's -Isrc -Isrc/z80, plus src/msdos for the osdepend rule. The directory on disk is `Z80` with a capital Z, and the makefile spells its -I lowercase -- harmless on the case-insensitive filesystem the archive was built for, and named here in the case it actually has so the target is not a guess about the host.
_defines: The makefile passes -DX86_ASM -DLSB_FIRST. X86_ASM is NOT set here: it selects the x86 assembly path, the same choice as Quake's id386=0 and Heretic's #ifndef __WATCOMC__.
